:::{#exr-affine-map-unique-practice}
#### Matching the offsets of two formulas for one affine map

@thm-affine-map-unique says that an [affine map](#def-affine-map) has only one [matrix](#def-matrix) and one [offset](#def-affine-offset),
so two ways of writing the same map must agree term by term.
For $c \in \reals$,
suppose that

$$
\sbmat{1 & 0 \\ 2 & 1} \vx + \sbmat{3 \\ 1}
= \sbmat{1 & 0 \\ 2 & 1} \vx + \sbmat{c \\ 1}
\quad \text{for every } \vx \in \reals^2.
$$

Find $c$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Compare the [offsets](#def-affine-offset) of the two sides.

:::
